name: Ring Row (Weighted)
instructions: Hang from rings at about waist height with a weight vest or plate, feet on the floor and body straight.
Pull your chest toward the rings, rotating your palms in.
longevityNotes: Pulling strength balances all the forward-reaching of daily life and protects the shoulders and upper back. A strong back is one of the best predictors of staying active and independent.
overview: A rowing exercise on gymnastic rings that builds the lats and biceps; the weight adds resistance.

sources.title: Original to the LIFT knowledge base

attribution: Original prose written for the LIFT knowledge base (CC BY 4.0).
safetyNotes: Make sure the rings are secure; use a lighter weight.
